proposals.title: Options bookmarks-index href should dismiss side panel
proposals.summary: Out of scope for REQ-LOCAL_BOOKMARKS_INDEX-dismiss-side-panel-on-open: options page uses a plain href to bookmarks-table.html, so it does not call OPEN_BOOKMARKS_INDEX_TAB and leaves an open side panel visible. Future CITDP: route options open through SW OPEN_BOOKMARKS_INDEX (or click handler) so create+REQUEST_SIDE_PANEL_CLOSE applies consistently.
